reason: The quote states that chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) is frequently diagnosed "during evaluation of splenomegaly." This directly supports that splenomegaly is a finding associated with CML. The disagreement stems from a semantic interpretation of the 'member_of' relation. In this claim structure, the finding (splenomegaly) is considered a member of the set of findings for the disease (CML), a relationship the quote supports.
